episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the current trends in the luxury real estate market, emphasizing the importance of pricing, presentation, and understanding local market nuances. She highlights the role of AI in enhancing property visualization and maintaining client relationships through personalized communication. The episode offers valuable insights for agents looking to excel in the luxury market.
